sentences.text:
This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e cour
 following:

This is first criminal appeal filed under Section 14-A(1) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, against the order of rejection of his bail by the trial Court for grant of regular bail to the appellant, who is in jail since 20.06.2023 in connection of Crime No.70/2023, registered at Police Station Thana Noorganj, District Raisen (M.P) for the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii),
3(2)(v)(a), 3(1)(da)(dha) of SC/ST Act.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the appellant submitted that prosecutrix has no objection if appellant is released on bail.
3. Learned counsel for the objector submitted that he has no objection if appellant is released on bail.
4. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State Government opposed the appeal for grant of bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
6.
Considering the no objection given by respondent no.2, appeal filed by the appellant is allowed.

7. It is directed that appellant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty thousand) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

8. In addition to that appellant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437 (3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
